judgements.reason: Condemns those who buy up housing until no room is left; names the injustice.
Desolation and no comforter, but a fallen city, not losing a home.
Tent destroyed, no one to rebuild; lament of lost home, children part extra.
Wages in a bag with holes fits, but 'consider your ways' blames them.
Oceans of tears across lifetimes; generic, not about debt despite effort.
About greed and the rich; this person is not greedy, they are sinking.
Hard choices between painful alternatives; names the bind without comfort.
Suicidal impulse during illness; off-topic and heavy for a money choice.
Travel does not cure the mind; nothing to do with this choice.
Anxiety comes from valuing externals; a real angle on money fear.
A mind trained to panic feels unsafe even when safe; exactly their doubt.
The unprepared panic at trifles; reflection as a remedy fits.
About when to ask friends for help, not how to refuse family.
Refusing a loan rarely loses a friend; blunt but on the question.
Urges more self-sacrifice; the opposite of the limits they need.
Rid yourself of opinion about poverty; dismisses a practical, real problem.
A rule for fathers; beside the point for the parent left holding on.
Soul not money counts with a child; faint comfort, misses the question.
Hidden wound no one can see; speaks to the gap with others.
Sickness hinders the body, not the self; directly on the body-self gap.
Joy on recovery; presumes a recovery they may not get.
Hidden inner wound; loosely about unseen pain, not fear for a loved one.
Quaking at death, but frames it as lost faith and a broken backbone.
'Only now learned death hangs over you' lands cold on someone terrified.
Heart throbbing in sleep as part of life's dance; a calming reframe.
Heart racing, night turned to trembling; shows someone else felt this.
Troubled sleep is common; waking to find the fear is nothing.
Says the trouble is emotional; echoes the doctors they feel dismissed by.
Calls those who cannot bear pain weaklings; harsh for real symptoms.
Treats the sore spot as trivial over-focus; would feel dismissive.
Sleepless night, eyelids held open, too troubled to speak; companionship.
Get enough sleep; they know, they cannot.
Hearing sounds that are not there as inner uproar; may read as 'imagined'.
Opinion makes pain heavier; speaks to catastrophising, a little brisk.
Don't ruin the present fearing the future; measure the fear. Exact.
Vain fear of future things that may never come; wait, consolation will come.
Which self is me; can read as shrugging off the years they lost.
Youthful lust and chastity; nothing to do with illness or lost years.
Youth cramming years with plans; beside the point of years taken away.
'You imagine them out of your own heart' would mock their flashbacks.
Loss taken by a bad man is only restored; speaks straight to the theft.
Confess to one another and pray; gently toward telling family.
Letting oneself be cheated for a private laugh; off-angle, could sting.
About why charlatans exist; beside the person's shame.
Money lost to a cheat buys prudence; kind reframe of self-blame.
Schoolboy wrong that grew into friendship; hope from the wronged side.
Being cheated for a laugh; unrelated to old guilt.
School-days sadness that still shadows; from the victim's side, off-angle.
Pretending not to know one is cheated; unrelated to gaslighting aftermath.
Owning crimes never committed to ease another; the gaslit habit named.
Never rely on memory alone; could deepen their doubt rather than steady it.
Despairing cry against prayer; nothing to do with the outburst.
Hold back words that hurt little ones; the storm will still, grace returns.
On topic but a bare command; reads as reproach to someone already broken.
Drop resentment because nothing can be done; invalidating for assault.
Evil for good, attackers rejoicing; mirrors the injustice they watch.
Don't be resentful when abused; feels like asking them to swallow it.
Ends choosing life, but introduces suicide to someone already low.
The other self grows on sorrow; vague for self-forgiveness.
Keyword 'cheated' only; about being wronged, not having wronged.
'Are you not ashamed' at letting others disturb you; lands badly here.
Trusted friend turned against me; names the betrayal plainly.
Taking on crimes never committed; exactly the self-blame they describe.
Lonely rich labourer asking whom he toils for; wrong situation.
Help comes from within, not others; a push toward agency.
Why am I singled out for poverty; searched, found no cause. Resonates.
Warns against restless moving; one side of their dilemma.
Same power in every place; reassures about leaving friends.
Changing has a cost with old friends; choose knowingly.
Deferring life to make money abroad; they love the job, not the money.
Leave your country and kin for a land to be shown; the call to go.
No description can show the new country; you know it by living there.
Hard to choose between painful alternatives and to hold to it.
Life or wealth, which do you hold dear; the exact question.
Hope for wealth is hard to give up; names the pull of the double salary.
Let go of seeming important; an angle on fearing exposure.
Be content to seem foolish; distrust being thought somebody.
Half our troubles are fear of what people will say; a bit accusing.
Many ahead, many behind; you have outstripped yourself. Direct.
Others preferred; rejoice or don't grieve. Fits comparison.
Ambition only looks at those ahead; names the trap.
Hidden self-seeking; loosely about motives, not excitement vs escape.
What is your motive, are you sure; the very test they asked for.
Change of soul, not climate; the escape trap named directly.
Blames slowness to pray; this person prays daily, so misdiagnoses.
Why dost Thou not speak, why so scarce; voices their cry exactly.
Spiritual dryness; keep knocking until a crumb of grace.
A ready prayer for fears rising against the soul; gives them words.
Stop praying, God doesn't care; undermines a believer wanting to pray.
Dry and without devotion, keep praying anyway; directly on point.
Faith on authority is not faith; a thoughtful angle on losing it.
A wave of religious feeling that fades; about gaining faith, not losing it.
Same passing wave; off-angle for a settled loss of belief.
Shock reveals the real nature; the glimpse must be practised. Exact.
Recover your life by looking afresh; fits reintegration.
The wave after a shock passes; a warning worth reading now.
Progress stops, you feel stranded; persevere, it rises and falls.
Never stop trying; diligence led to awakening. Stern encouragement.
Work harder and meditation gives deepest rest; answers 'why keep going'.
Faithfulness not found where expected; we are weak; hope in God.
Why leave church, the street is as false; on staying despite distrust.
Casts the person as impatient and hard to admonish; misplaced blame.
Passing religious impulse after a death; not their steady questioning.
Life plays in death's face; death is not ultimate. A way of living with it.
Same passing wave; loosely about death, misses the question.
Honest livelihood lets you provide for parents; fits no more borrowing.
Well done, good and faithful servant; enter into joy. Celebration.
Work best when working for others; beside the point of this joy.
Calls late risers base churls; shames the small win.
Rising to a human being's work; affirms getting up, slightly chiding.
Getting up to act is your nature; gentle yes, it counts.
Change of soul not climate; assumes travel, generic for 'blah'.
Gloom may be dyspepsia; comes across as a quip at their expense.
Leaden weakness, years of weariness; mirrors the feeling, no lift.
Love cultivated brings easy sleep and love of non-humans; a warm fit.
Spiritual lethargy as sleep; nothing to do with a dog's trust.
Lying down with sympathy for creatures; shares a note, mostly about the Buddha.
Clear minds need no intoxicant; affirms the year sober.
Craving gone, mind unclouded; echoes clear eyes and peace.
Uses sobriety as a veil to burn; would jar on a sobriety anniversary.
Glad to be in this world after hardship; a quiet birthday note.
Solitude as the best companion; honours celebrating alone.
Which age is the real me; only loosely a birthday thought.
Thankful for small mercies; offers the something good they asked for.
Glad to be in this great world despite suffering; a small good.
Tells them not to trust good news; the opposite of what they asked.
Long-awaited small moment; shares 'waited long' but not mixed feelings.
Don't over-rejoice, fortune turns; names why joy comes tempered.
Grieving over one's own grief; the feeling about a feeling.
Whirled around with no object to direct every movement; exact.
The pause when the mind wants something beyond; reframes the drift.
Lost like straws on water, not knowing life's meaning; mirrors lost at sea.
Friends abhorring him; this person fears telling, hasn't been abandoned.
Accept the inevitable, others mourning; grief register, not a layoff.
This could happen to anyone; not crushed by it. Meets the undeserved blow.
